Load Shared Objects for dMod Objects

Source: R/compile.R
loadDLL.Rd

Loads the shared objects of dMod functions by their model names and the names of their generated sources, e.g. after restoring a workspace in a new R session. Searched are the working directory, getOption("dMod2.outdir") and the directories the sources were generated in. Shared objects already loaded are skipped.

Usage

loadDLL(...)

Arguments

...

objects of class prdfn, obsfn, parfn or objfn.

Value

Character vector of the files loaded by this call, invisibly.

See also

compile(), modelname()

Examples

# \donttest{
g <- Y(c(y = "s * x"), parameters = "s", modelname = "loadDLL_ex",
       compile = TRUE, outdir = tempdir())
#> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC -fopenmp]
loadDLL(g)
# }
